<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern—a prominent M+2 peak at m/z 185.042 with an intensity about one‑third of the base peak (≈33 % of the intensity at m/z 183.045)—the only element that shows this characteristic ~3:1 M : M+2 ratio is chlorine (natural 35Cl/37Cl abundances ≈75.8 %/24.2 %). No ~1:1 pattern (bromine) or ~4 % M+2 pattern (sulfur) is present, and other elements do not have a uniquely diagnostic isotopic signature in this spectrum. Therefore chlorine is the sole element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
